segments.ja98:1.1: Sādhu kho paṇḍito nāma, na tveva atipaṇḍito;
segments.ja98:1.3: Atipaṇḍitena puttena, manamhi upakūḷitoti [upakūlitoti (sī.), upakuṭṭhitoti (syā.), upakuṭito (ka.)].

lines: Tattha sādhu kho paṇḍito nāmāti imasmiṃ loke paṇḍiccena samannāgato kāraṇākāraṇaññū puggalo sādhu sobhano.
Atipaṇḍitoti nāmamattena atipaṇḍito kūṭapuriso na tveva varaṃ.
Manamhi upakūḷitoti thokenamhi jhāmo, aḍḍhajjhāmakova muttoti attho.
Te ubhopi majjhe bhinditvā samaññeva koṭṭhāsaṃ gaṇhitvā yathākammaṃ gatā.
